source_caption_text:
Megan Thee Stallion shared an update on Miso, the cat she found outside her studio and his journey from street cat to a new home is so sweet 🥹❤️

Megan said she first spotted Miso after someone moved out of their apartment and left him behind. She didn’t want to force him to come home with her because she felt like he was enjoying life outside, so she let him stay nearby.

Then, after what Megan described as a bad day, Miso jumped into her car and finally went home with her. She took him to the vet, where he was treated for parasites, and he’s now settling in with Megan. She also found out Miso is a boy and that he’s already neutered 😭🐈

The update has already drawn a huge response, with the video passing 900,000 likes. We’re glad Miso is safe and getting the care he needs. ❤️
